question: Add a new method CompactWithDeletionMarkers(ctx context.Context, markers []DeletionMark) error to the Syncer in thanos/pkg/compact. Mimir's compactor embeds Thanos Syncer for multi-tenant block lifecycle management. This new method enables deletion-mark-aware compaction.

answer.where_to_add: After the GarbageCollect method (after line 249 in compact.go)

DeletionMark.definition: type DeletionMark struct { ID ulid.ULID `json:"id"`; Version int `json:"version"`; Details string `json:"details,omitempty"`; DeletionTime int64 `json:"deletion_time"` }

integration_with_mimir.explanation: Mimir's compactor defines its own unexported metaSyncer struct (not embedding Thanos Syncer directly) that mirrors Thanos Syncer's structure. Mimir's metaSyncer has its own SyncMetas, Metas, and GarbageCollect methods. To leverage CompactWithDeletionMarkers in Mimir, Mimir's metaSyncer would need either: (a) a similar method added that accepts []block.DeletionMark and filters blocks before compaction planning, or (b) Mimir could switch to embedding or wrapping the Thanos Syncer to inherit this method. Currently Mimir's SyncMetas already calls FetchWithoutMarkedForDeletion which handles deletion marks at fetch time, so this new Thanos method provides a complementary mechanism for runtime deletion-mark injection.

fields_used_by_new_method: bkt (objstore.Bucket) - for uploading deletion marks to object storage
mtx (sync.Mutex) - for thread-safe access to blocks map
blocks (map[ulid.ULID]*metadata.Meta) - to remove marked blocks from in-memory state

existing_syncer_methods: SyncMetas(ctx context.Context) error - syncs block metadata from bucket
Metas() map[ulid.ULID]*metadata.Meta - returns loaded block metadata
GarbageCollect(ctx context.Context, justDeletedBlocks map[ulid.ULID]struct{}) error - marks duplicate blocks for deletion
answer.design_rationale: The method follows the same patterns as GarbageCollect: it acquires the mutex to modify s.blocks, uses block.MarkForDeletion to persist deletion marks to object storage, uses a detached context with timeout for each mark operation to ensure completion even on shutdown, and increments the BlocksMarkedForDeletion metric. The key difference is that instead of computing which blocks to delete (via duplicate detection), it accepts externally-provided DeletionMark entries, enabling Mimir's multi-tenant compactor to drive deletion-mark-aware compaction per tenant.

tool_calls.purpose: find Mimir's usage of Thanos compact
